No actionable issues in snapshot `997ACEA0...`.

Contracts/layout/clipping verified in supplied `scripts/ui/shop_offer.gd` + `scenes/shop/shop_offer.tscn`:
- Resource `res://assets/shop/vendor_v1/vendor-portrait.png` wired as `ExtResource("3_portrait")` to `Stage/VendorPortrait`; `load_steps=4` correct; script needs no change — portrait static.
- Geometry holds: portrait `8..72,0..64` 64x64 1:1; `Heading 76..568,5..19` / `Hint 76..568,23..37` left-aligned `center_text=false`, `max_lines=1`; width 492px > longest hint 210px; `Cards 64..304`, `Prices 306..324` no overlap.
- Text `!`-free confirmed; widths @6px advance fit: `PREÇO/COMPRADO` 48px in 160px cells, `LOJA - SUCATA` grows safely, all caps/Ç/Í/`-` claimed audited.
- Readability/regression: beige/grey/gold `#d2a75c`/teal `#62c6a5` on `Color(0.015,0.025,0.035,0.88)`; `mouse_filter=2`, `texture_filter=1`, `expand 1/stretch 5` correct for 64x64 pixel-art; no prior contract broken.

Engine-only unknowns (not actionable here): actual `font.json`/PNG bytes/palette, missing-texture load failure, `HudBitmapText:max_lines=1` truncation vs wrap, `upgrade_card.tscn` width vs `Price0-2` 160px cells, non-16:9 integer-scale crispness.
